title: "Open in terminal" menu item, like in Dolphin (for directory's context menu)
line: Right-clicking a folder on the desktop now offers Open Terminal Here, like in Dolphin.
explanation: Folder View's item context menu (FolderModel::openContextMenu) only had the open-with, clipboard, trash and service-menu entries, so a folder on the desktop had no way to open a terminal in it, while Dolphin shows Open Terminal Here for folders. The empty-area menu's Open Terminal (bug 451217) is a separate containment action and doesn't cover items. The change adds an Open Terminal Here action, shown when every selected item is a local folder and shell access is allowed, placed through KFileItemActions' additional actions exactly where Dolphin puts it; it opens the default terminal (KTerminalLauncherJob) in each selected folder.

commits.message:
foldermodel: add Open Terminal Here to the folder item menu

Right-clicking a folder on the desktop or in Folder View offered no way
to open a terminal in it, unlike Dolphin. Add an Open Terminal Here
action for local folders that opens a terminal in each selected folder.

BUG: 459033

media.caption: Right-clicking the Projects folder on the desktop: no terminal entry
Same menu with the fix: Open Terminal Here, in the same place as in Dolphin
Clicking it opens Konsole in ~/altdesk/Projects (the desktop folder on this rig)
With two folders selected it is offered too and opens one terminal in each
